STAT_ONLINE_TEXT : Online / Offline Status as text with values from table TOnlineStateTable
STAT_CONNECTION_ATTEMPS : Number of connection retries of current (if active) or last session
STAT_START_TIME_DATE : Start of current (if active) or last session
STAT_END_TIME_DATE : End of current (if active) or last session
STAT_BYTES_RECEIVED : Bytes received within last or current session (download)
STAT_BYTES_SENT : Bytes sent within last or current session (upload)
STAT_PHONE_NO : Telephone number of the RAS server or AP number if GPRS
STAT_MODE : Digital, analogues or other dial-in
STAT_SIM_MNC : MNC (mobile network code) of SIM
STAT_SIM_MCC : MCC (mobile country code) of SIM
STAT_IP_NO : IP-number of the last or current connection
